title: Efficient Nuclei Usage
description: Use the thousands of templates in the image as a weapon library
detail: 1) Full quick scan: nuclei -u T -severity critical,high -c 50. 2) Targeted: -tags log4j/spring, etc. 3) Offline without template updates: use the built-in version. 4) Avoid crashing targets: rate-limit with -rl 20 and exclude DoS/fuzz categories. 5) On a hit, immediately record a sapper fact with -k vuln -d cve=xxx. Crashing a target means zero points; slower is better.
